name: Notion
manual_step: In Notion: create an internal integration (Settings, Connections, Develop or manage integrations; read content is enough), then open each top-level page to back up and add the integration under Connections. Paste the token when you Connect, or put NOTION_API_KEY in ~/.notion-mirror/mirror.env and Connect again.
description: Pulls every page and database the integration can see into one lane, daily, in the layout Notion's own export uses. No read wire: Notion is a source the brain backs up, not an agent that consults it.

secret.label: Notion integration token
secret.help: Settings, Connections, Develop or manage integrations. Read content is enough. The token is stored in ~/.notion-mirror/mirror.env on this machine only.
